status: offline infrastructure, mock-only entry point; not formal research results
H_adapter_export: separate mock complementary set; never substituted into U experiment silently
evaluation_split: train or tracked synthetic tiny only
action_protocol: one U call; selected h scores all legal pairs; append-only; stable job/machine ties
language: closed numeric AST-v1, not arbitrary Python; all arms share restrictions
execution: spawned worker; per-instance wall deadline includes two complete deterministic checks and first worker startup; terminate then kill
sandbox_scope: AST gate blocks imports, attributes, containers, reflection, resource access, external names/calls; no general OS sandbox
dedup: AST key ignoring comments/docstrings/annotations; same score is not duplicate; not semantic equivalence
resume: source/data/H/protocol locked; completed requests/evaluations reused; uncertain pending ones invalidated without repetition
request_count: each reservation charged; interrupted dispatch uncertain, never claimed as a verified actual provider request
recording: summary events by default; complete action trace only for 3-step tiny replay; no auto model calls for UI
